text: I am sorry to hear you are experiencing mental status changes; to help me understand the cause, can you tell me when these symptoms first started and if you have noticed any fever or recent head injury? Additionally, have you been experiencing confusion, memory loss, or changes in your speech?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details, Mrs. Smith. Given your age, significant smoking history, and recent onset of confusion without trauma, have you been experiencing any shortness of breath, cough, or fever? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Blood_Culture, Arterial_Blood_Gas.

speaker: Doctor
text: With your vital signs and blood work all normal, have you noticed any muscle weakness, numbness in your legs, or difficulty walking recently? Also, do you have any history of back pain or recent infections?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Mental status changes. I also have Increased confusion, Lethargy.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your blood work and initial assessment are normal, but you are experiencing progressive confusion and lethargy, have you noticed any severe headache, vision changes, or loss of consciousness? Additionally, have you had any recent falls or episodes of fainting?
